Mouse mode

Mouse mode: Navigate moves the linked 3D cursor by click or drag. To segment, choose Segment, a compartment and Local CT seed, then click within the blood. The seed is limited by Radius (30–100 HU) rather than selecting the entire connected tissue. Use Local 3D grow/shrink to refine the contour: hold for a larger preview, release to commit. Right-drag or Shift-drag navigates in either mode.
